text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Tender for the Roof and Skylight Replacement Project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Authorized the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo, to award the tender for roof replacement of the Giraffe House roof – Request for Tender TZC T 39-2020-10 - Roof Replacement: Canopy Classroom, Giraffe House, Education, to Provincial Roofing in the amount of $313,558.05, including applicable taxes.
